newsitem.title: GERMANY: Camdessus - Europe shows money stability culture.
newsitem.headline: Camdessus - Europe shows money stability culture.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) president Michael Camdessus said on Friday that a culture of monetary stability already exists in Europe.
"A culture of stability exists more than you may think," Camdessus told reporters at a conference of the Christian Social Union political party.
European governments have shown commitment to economic stability by slashing budget deficits, the IMF chief said. "The stability culture is developing very rapidly," he said.
Camdessus added that European central banks are also showing themselves to be increasingly of the same mind on monetary issues.

Many Germans are worried that the future European currency will not be as stable as the mark because other European countries may not share the Bundesbank's commitment to low inflation and stable exchange rates.
